 Santiago & Romero Law Group
 Baytown, TX
 Phone 832-555-2357
 Letter of Representation
05/31/2025
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1194
Our client: Zachary Jenkins
Date of loss: 04/17/2025
Dear Claims Representative:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the head-on collision described in your
file. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by
telephone, mail, or in person. Our client was injured in a low-speed impact and is undergoing medical evaluation, and we will
forward supporting records as they become available.
Please provide a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in force at the time of the accident, together with the stated
bodily injury and property damage limits and a statement of any other coverage that may apply. We also ask that you confirm in
writing whether any excess or umbrella coverage exists.
Finally, we request that your insurer preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle
data and event recorder information, telephone and recorded statements, repair and appraisal records, and any surveillance or
third-party reports. Please treat this letter as a formal notice to preserve these materials, and confirm receipt so that we may
proceed accordingly.
Sincerely,
Kristin Romero
Santiago & Romero Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
